verdict.rationale: Motion's own docs describe AI-generated suggestions and insights drawn from the user's work data inside the product. It analyzes all your work to highlight your #1 priority, warns proactively about at-risk tasks and off-track projects, predicts project finish dates from team capacity, flags over-scheduling, and its notetaker produces action items. Missing for 10: a general-purpose insight surface over your data (the documented AI search only finds items, it does not analyze them), in-depth docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how good these insights are.
